summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K to disclose a Settlement, Release and Amendment Agreement with Live Oak Sponsor Partners II, LLC regarding 10,000,000 earnout shares from the 2021 business combination. The settlement transfers 726,225 sponsor earnout shares to Live Oak Sponsor (no longer subject to vesting/forfeiture), plus 421,000 previously earned shares, while forfeiting 115,775 shares. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The agreement includes mutual release of claims and confidentiality/non-disparagement. This resolves a legacy contractual dispute rather than a transformative corporate event, making it not a special situation.
